I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread: I noted that the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats and said I'd take no other action.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, and she posted it herself in that channel, so repeating it there was fine. I didn't read #north-team and didn't repeat the old figure. I also told her the #north-team post still needs fixing, either by editing it herself or by asking me to post a correction there.
